title: Replace ill-anime / pony-mix - RentCivit-only licences block commercial output
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-528 - The licensing surface (consolidation sweep 2026-08-14). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-528/plan.md.

Per docs/models/community-merges-licences.md (MPI-430), ill-anime (animemix, koronen, CivitAI 933065) and pony-mix (ANImergeMEij, reijlita, CivitAI 734527) both grant RentCivit ONLY - no Image flag - so users CANNOT commercially use output generated with them. Both also carry allowNoCredit:false. MPI-430 judged the community merges low-risk for a FREE app, which is still true for the app itself, but the restriction bites users directly and bites any paid Flow built on either.

WORK: find replacement Illustrious / Pony checkpoints with a clean Image commercial-use grant, or merge our own as we already did for wan-22-i2v-high/low. Also confirm whether ill-anime-beauty (RAMTHRUST'S-NSFW-PINK-ALCHEMY-ANIMA, CivitAI 2578175, allowDerivatives:false) is simply Illustrious with LoRAs merged in - if so it is reproducible from a cleanly-licensed base. Note that model page is already unstable: the version we host is 6.46GB and the surviving listed versions are 3.90GB.

CONSTRAINT: provenance for these was resolved by filename + creator, NOT by hash - only wan-22-t2v-high/low matched upstream byte-for-byte. Any replacement should be hash-resolvable so a future sweep can see it.

ON REMOVAL: keep the dep entries so the orphan sweep can reclaim the weights from users who already have them (the MPI-470 pattern), and add the retired ids to the tombstone ledger.

RELATED: MPI-430 (the licence sweep that surfaced this), MPI-528 (licensing surface - gated installs and creator attribution), the tombstone ledger card.
